ev-packs.intro.say: This chooses the packs your code is checked against when you run /ev-run.

ev-packs.damaged.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged. Run /ev-activate and sign in with the same account as before.

ev-packs.not-signed-in.say: This machine isn't set up for Evalation yet. Run /ev-start to set it up.

ev-packs.unreachable.say: Evalation couldn't be reached. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-packs again.

ev-packs.clock.say: This machine's clock is wrong. Set it to the right time, then run /ev-packs again.

ev-packs.refused.say: Evalation no longer accepts this machine. Email support@evalation.ai to sort it out.

ev-packs.ended.say: This machine's access to Evalation has ended. To renew it, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-packs.other.say: Evalation couldn't check this machine just now. Run /ev-packs again in a few minutes.

ev-packs.what-a-pack.say: A pack is one thing your code is checked against, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, a security hardening review, or a review for a cyber insurer or investor. You can pick several.

ev-packs.gone-pack.say: a pack Evalation no longer offers

options.label: Choose packs again
options.description: Pick from every pack Evalation offers.

ev-packs.kept.say: Your checks still use <titles>, <count> pack credits each time.

ev-packs.kept-one.say: Your checks still use <titles>, one pack credit each time.

ev-packs.not-enough.say: A check won't start until you have more. Run /ev-account to buy some.

ev-packs.cost.say: Each pack uses one pack credit every time your code is checked.

ev-packs.which.ask: Which packs should your checks use?

ev-packs.nothing-changed.say: Nothing changed. Your checks still use <titles>.

ev-packs.nothing-chosen.say: Nothing changed. No packs are chosen yet.

ev-packs.short.say: These packs use <count> pack credits each time, and you have <credits>, so a check won't start. Run /ev-account to buy more.

options.label: Save these packs
options.description: A check starts once you have enough pack credits.

options.label: Choose packs again
options.description: Pick from every pack Evalation offers.

ev-packs.saved.say: Your checks now use <titles>, <count> pack credits each time.

ev-packs.saved-one.say: Your checks now use <titles>, one pack credit each time.

ev-packs.next.say: Next, run /ev-run to check a repository.

ev-packs.not-followed.say: That isn't one of the choices.

ev-packs.unreadable.say: Evalation sent a pack list this plugin can't read. Run /ev-packs again in a few minutes.

ev-packs.choice-unreadable.say: Your saved packs couldn't be read. Choose them again.

ev-packs.summary-cyber-insurance.say: What a cyber insurer asks before it offers cover, answered from your code.

ev-packs.summary-dora.say: EU rules on how banks, insurers and other financial firms manage technology risk.

ev-packs.summary-eu-ai-act.say: EU duties for anyone who builds, sells or uses an AI system.

ev-packs.summary-gdpr.say: EU rules on collecting and handling personal data.

ev-packs.summary-hardening.say: Whether your code would stand up to attackers, outages and mistakes.

ev-packs.summary-hipaa.say: US rules for keeping health information private and secure.

ev-packs.summary-investment-diligence.say: What investors and buyers check in a company's software.

ev-packs.summary-ism.say: Australian Government security controls for systems that handle government information.

ev-packs.summary-iso42001.say: The international certification for managing AI systems.

ev-packs.summary-nist-ai-rmf.say: US guidance on finding and managing the risks of AI systems.

ev-packs.summary-nist-csf.say: US framework for running a security programme.

ev-packs.summary-nist-ssdf.say: US practices for building software securely.

ev-packs.summary-nz-privacy-act.say: New Zealand rules on collecting and handling personal information.

ev-packs.summary-owasp-agentic-threats.say: Known attacks on AI agents and how to counter them.

ev-packs.summary-owasp-agentic-top-ten.say: The ten biggest security risks in apps built on AI agents.

ev-packs.summary-owasp-asvs.say: Detailed security requirements for web applications.

ev-packs.summary-pci-dss.say: Rules for anyone who takes or stores card payments.

ev-packs.summary-soc2.say: The US security audit most business software customers ask for.
